## Software

Start with the [software and access requirements](software-requirements.qmd).
They distinguish required access from personal installation, identify the six
R packages actually used by the course, and link to runnable MATLAB and R setup
checks.

Instructors preparing a teaching room or the live course should use the
[laboratory and Blackboard readiness checklist](instructor-setup-checklist.qmd).
Laboratory availability is not assumed until that check is recorded.

## References

- MATLAB documentation: <https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/>
- R for Data Science, 2e: <https://r4ds.hadley.nz/>
- ggplot2 documentation: <https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/>
- dplyr documentation: <https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/>
- Quarto documentation: <https://quarto.org/docs/>

## Setup Checklist

1. Run the [MATLAB setup check](../code/setup/check-matlab-setup.m) before
   Week 1 and confirm the separate symbolic status before Week 5.
2. Run the [R setup check](../code/setup/check-r-setup.R) before Week 6.
3. Confirm that Quarto can render the supplied Week 6 scaffold.
4. Create a persistent folder for course work and test ZIP extraction.
5. Confirm that a project template can be exported to PDF.
